title: Sold a product then relaunched the product as new
body: I feel cheated as I bought this Daily Routines when it first came out as a one time purchase app. Now the developer has completely abandoned the original app and relaunched as a new product with a subscription model. Without fathering in the existing customers or even offering a discount to the existing customers, so they could by the lifetime purchase at a discounted price. Or could have atleast left the old app in a working state so that it did not crash on every small change.
author: mayhembro

title: Junk App
body: Without even giving a free version or showing how the app works, They are casually asking for a huge amount for signup.
author: x848

title: Too complicated
body: I bet this is a useful app, but I couldn’t figure how to use it. There’s no proper guide or assistance offered within the app either. I deleted it after trying to make it work for a good 30 minutes.
